class.name: LiveWallpaper
class.brief_description: Runtime singleton that parents a Blazium window to the Windows desktop WorkerW as an animated wallpaper.
class.description: [LiveWallpaper] is compiled when the livewallpaper module is enabled. Command-line switches apply only when [code]blazium/livewallpaper/enabled[/code] is [code]true[/code]. Run mode finds the desktop WorkerW ([code]Progman[/code] + [code]0x052C[/code]) and parents the engine window as a [code]WS_CHILD[/code] behind the icons. Preview ([code]--livewallpaper-preview[/code] or [code]/p[/code]) stays a normal window and never attaches. [code]--livewallpaper-quit[/code] signals a running instance to exit.

method.name: get_mode
method.description: Returns the active livewallpaper mode, or [constant MODE_DISABLED] when the project setting is off.

method.name: get_workerw
method.description: Returns the WorkerW HWND used as the embed parent, or [code]0[/code] in preview / when not attached.

method.name: is_attached
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when run mode found a WorkerW and the window is embedded.

constants.constant: Project setting is off, or no livewallpaper mode was applied.
Attach to the desktop WorkerW (default when enabled).
Windowed preview that does not attach ([code]--livewallpaper-preview[/code] or [code]/p[/code]).
Signal a running instance to exit ([code]--livewallpaper-quit[/code]).
